#"'!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Create the approved sample-level PCA from gene counts."""
from pathlib import Path
import os
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from sklearn.decomposition import PCA

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
PROJECT = HERE.parents[1]
counts_path = PROJECT / "02_bioinformatics/rnaseq_bulk/01_nfcore-rnaseq-wrapper/run/results/star_salmon/salmon.merged.gene_counts_length_scaled.tsv"
design_path = PROJECT / "01_samplesheets/rnaseq_bulk_design.csv"
counts = pd.read_csv(counts_path, sep="'"\\t\", index_col=0)
design = pd.read_csv(design_path)

# nf-core count table includes gene_name metadata; retain only columns matching design samples.
samples = design[\"sample_id\"].astype(str).tolist()
missing = [s for s in samples if s not in counts.columns]
if missing:
    raise ValueError(\"Design samples missing from counts: \" + \", \".join(missing))
values = counts[samples].apply(pd.to_numeric, errors=\"raise\").to_numpy(dtype=float)
logged = np.log2(values + 1.0)
variances = np.var(logged, axis=1)
# Stable descending variance order makes ties deterministic in input row order.
indices = np.argsort(-variances, kind=\"mergesort\")[:min(500, len(variances))]
selected = logged[indices, :]
means = selected.mean(axis=1, keepdims=True)
stds = selected.std(axis=1, keepdims=True)
scaled = np.divide(selected - means, stds, out=np.zeros_like(selected), where=stds "'!= 0)
model = PCA(n_components=2, random_state=0)
coordinates = model.fit_transform(scaled.T)

out = HERE / "results"
out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
result = pd.DataFrame({"sample_id": samples, "PC1": coordinates[:, 0], "PC2": coordinates[:, 1],
                       "condition": design["condition"].astype(str).tolist(),
                       "PC1_explained_variance_fraction": model.explained_variance_ratio_[0],
                       "PC2_explained_variance_fraction": model.explained_variance_ratio_[1]})
result.to_csv(out / "sample_pca_coordinates.csv", index=False)

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 6))
palette = {"untreated": "#2878B5", "treated": "#D9534F"}
for condition in ("untreated", "treated"):
    mask = result["condition"] == condition
    ax.scatter(result.loc[mask, "PC1"], result.loc[mask, "PC2"], label=condition,
               color=palette[condition], s=75, edgecolor="white", linewidth=0.7)
for _, row in result.iterrows():
    ax.annotate(row["sample_id"], (row["PC1"], row["PC2"]), xytext=(5, 5),
                textcoords="offset points", fontsize=9)
ax.set_xlabel("PC1 ({:.1%} variance)".format(model.explained_variance_ratio_[0]))
ax.set_ylabel("PC2 ({:.1%} variance)".format(model.explained_variance_ratio_[1]))
ax.set_title("Sample PCA")
ax.legend(title="Condition")
fig.tight_layout()
fig.savefig(out / "sample_pca.png", dpi=160)
